run_robustness_eval_cli: run the robustness eval CLI to analyze corruption results for a COCO dataset model file
get_coco_style_results: get COCO style mAP results from a corruption benchmark eval output file with configurable metrics
get_voc_style_results: get Pascal VOC style AP50 results from a corruption benchmark eval output file
get_results: get aggregated corruption benchmark results for COCO, VOC, or Cityscapes datasets with configurable task and metrics
get_distortions_from_file: get the list of distortion names from a corruption benchmark eval output file
